# EWS protocol defaults distinguish internal scheme exposure from external handlers

The historical defaults explicitly set network.protocol-handler.expose.x-moz-ews to false for an internal-only scheme. Separate external-handler defaults are false for ews, ews-message and x-moz-ews. The checked accepted file retains those entries and has later Graph equivalents. The original commit states that exposure was already false and names prevention of future accidental exposure and web handler registration as intent. A false default is not a new protocol-service execution trace or proof of every navigation path; consumer implementation and handler-registration tests remain separate gaps. No new assertion or test was part of this patch.

Scope: Thunderbird EWS protocol preference defaults.
